title: Plan: Fixed Stars
description:
Port fixed star computation from sweph.c (~1000 lines).

## Functions
- `swe_fixstar2(star, tjd, iflag, xx, serr)` — main entry. Loads all stars on first call via load_all_fixed_stars(). Searches by name, Bayer designation, or catalog number.
- `swe_fixstar2_ut()` — UT wrapper
- `swe_fixstar2_mag()` — magnitude lookup
- `swe_fixstar()` / `swe_fixstar_ut()` / `swe_fixstar_mag()` — older versions (can skip or alias)

## Position computation (catalogue-internal §20.2)
1. Epoch transform if catalog epoch ≠ J2000: RA/Dec + proper motion × (J2000 − epoch)
2. Precession J2000 → observation date
3. Proper motion velocity vector also precessed
4. Annual aberration + gravitational deflection (same pipeline as planets)
5. Sidereal transform if SEFLG_SIDEREAL

## Star catalog
- `sefstars.txt` (~9000 stars) in ephe/ directory
- `struct fixed_star`: skey, starname, starbayer, starno, epoch, ra, de, ramot, demot, radvel, parall, mag
- Built-in array of major stars as fallback when file unavailable

## Rust design
- `StarCatalog` struct owned by Ephemeris, lazily loaded
- Search: HashMap by name + HashMap by Bayer designation for O(1) lookup
- `Star` struct with all catalog fields

## Testing
- setest/suite_02_fixstar.c
- Golden data: Sirius, Spica, Aldebaran, Regulus at various epochs

## C source reference
- sweph.c swe_fixstar2, load_all_fixed_stars, star search logic
- Catalog file: ephe/sefstars.txt

## Dependencies
- Phase 3 (precession), Phase 5 (apparent position pipeline)
execution_record:
Planning task. Produced docs/c-ref-fixstar.md (1179 lines: catalog format, struct, loading, search, builtin fallback, the 18-step fixstar_calc_from_struct position pipeline, swi_icrs2fk5/swi_FK4_FK5 frame transforms, and the 12-mode fixed-star ayanamsa integration) and decomposed into 4 implementation sub-tasks on this arc (arc_phase=implement): swisseph-rs/54 (catalog parser+types+search+builtin), /55 (Moshier position pipeline + Ephemeris fixstar2/_ut/_mag), /56 (12 fixed-star ayanamsa modes + armc_to_mc), /57 (SWIEPH+JPL star backends). Chain: 55→54, 56→55, 57→55; all refine /10.

Corrections to the original (pre-architecture) task description:
1. StarCatalog is NOT "lazily loaded" — it is eager-loaded at Ephemeris::new() and stored as a read-only field (like planet_files/jpl_file). The stateless invariant forbids a mutable/lazy cache.
2. Position math placed in calc.rs (calc_fixstar), not stars.rs — stars.rs holds only catalog data/parsing/search so it imports no backend (satisfies the forbidden_dep constraints, now uncommented). Ephemeris dispatches to calc::calc_fixstar exactly as it does for calc_planet.
3. Fixed-star ayanamsa modes are routed at the Ephemeris layer (where the catalog lives), not inside ayanamsa.rs's pure config-math functions; ayanamsa.rs keeps its Err(SiderealModeRequiresFixedStars) as a safety net.
4. Blank-line handling (note 2): the Rust parser skips blank AND whitespace-only lines silently — fixing the C 'data corrupted' bug; more lenient than C.
5. New scope not in the original task: swi_icrs2fk5 + swi_FK4_FK5 frame transforms are required because swe_fixstar2 prefers built-in stars BEFORE the file, and the built-in ayanamsa reference stars carry epoch 2000 (",SgrA*") / 1950 (",GP1958"). Documented and folded into /55.
6. Backend sequencing: Moshier-first (/55) per project process; SWIEPH/JPL star backends split into /57 to keep each sub-task single-session.
7. Note 1 (uncomment ayanamsa+stars constraints in .sutra/rules.toml) folded in: stars constraints in /54, ayanamsa constraints in /56.
8. The legacy swe_fixstar/_ut/_mag (file-scan) API is aliased to fixstar2 (same math) rather than ported separately.

DEFERRED FROM swisseph-rs/9 (Ayanamsa): the 12 "true star" / galactic ayanamsa modes depend on swe_fixstar and are NOT implemented by the ayanamsa sub-tasks (49-52). This task (Fixed Stars) is responsible for implementing them once the fixed-star subsystem exists.

The 12 deferred SiderealMode indices and their reference stars / offsets (full detail in docs/c-ref-ayanamsa.md §"Fixed-Star Ayanamsas"):
- 17 GALCENT_0SAG (",SgrA*", x-240°), 27 TRUE_CITRA ("Spica", x-180°), 28 TRUE_REVATI (",zePsc", x-359.8333°), 29 TRUE_PUSHYA (",deCnc", x-106°), 30 GALCENT_RGILBRAND (",SgrA*"), 31 GALEQU_IAU1958 (",GP1958", x-150°), 32 GALEQU_TRUE (",GPol", x-150°), 33 GALEQU_MULA (",GPol"), 35 TRUE_MULA (",laSco", x-240°), 36 GALCENT_MULA_WILHELM (",SgrA*", equatorial+swi_armc_to_mc), 39 TRUE_SHEORAN (",deCnc"), 40 GALCENT_COCHRANE (",SgrA*", x-270°).

Implementation hooks already in place after sub-tasks 49-52:
- `ayanamsa::get_ayanamsa_ex` returns `Err(Error::SiderealModeRequiresFixedStars(mode))` for these indices — replace that early-return with the swe_fixstar-based computation (C: sweph.c:3049-3142, documented in the ref doc).
- `EphemerisConfig::set_sidereal_mode` already strips projection bits for these modes (matches C); no config change needed.
- The galactic-pole modes (31,32,33) use iflag | SEFLG_TRUEPOS; the others pass TRUEPOS/NOABERR/NOGDEFL through from the caller. Index 36 needs swi_armc_to_mc (swehouse.c:872-888) which arrives with the houses module.

Add golden coverage for these 12 modes (via swe_get_ayanamsa_ex and swe_calc+SEFLG_SIDEREAL) when implementing.
